priorityList: Invoke Xuen the White Tiger on large pulls or when Zenith is ready to be used.
Use Zenith (Master of Harmony) while Xuen is active, during Bloodlust, or when your major strikes (RSK, FoF) are on cooldown.
Cast Celestial Conduit while Zenith is active, ideally when Fists of Fury and Strike of the Windlord are on cooldown.
Cast Fists of Fury if the Heart of the Jade Serpent buff is about to expire or if you have reached 30 stacks of Flurry Charge.
Cast Whirling Dragon Punch whenever available (requires both Fists of Fury and Rising Sun Kick to be on cooldown).
Use Tiger Palm to generate Chi if Zenith is active and you need Chi for Fists of Fury, or to prevent capping Energy.
Cast Strike of the Windlord on cooldown, prioritizing windows where Celestial Conduit or Zenith buffs are active.
Use Fists of Fury as your primary AoE spender, especially if Zenith is not active.
Cast Rushing Wind Kick on cooldown.
Cast Rising Sun Kick in AoE to enable Whirling Dragon Punch or while the Rushing Wind Kick or Heart of the Jade Serpent buffs are active.
Use Touch of Death on low-health targets, prioritizing use outside of your active Zenith windows.
Use Spinning Crane Kick when Dance of Chi-Ji is active, especially if the proc is about to expire.
Use Blackout Kick to consume Combo Breaker procs or to spend Chi during Zenith windows when Fists of Fury is on cooldown.
Use Spinning Crane Kick as your main filler Chi spender in AoE (3+ targets) when higher-priority abilities are unavailable.
Always maintain Mastery: Combo Strikes by never casting the same ability twice in a row.
